'''Kuvale''' is a Southern [[Bantu language]] spoken in [[Angola]], in the middle of a large [[Umbundu language|Umbundu]]-speaking area. It has traditionally been considered a dialect of [[Herero language|Herero]]; however, Maho (2009) has moved it from Bantu Zone R.30 to Zone R.10, which includes Umbundu and a few smaller languages.<ref name="Guthrie"/> Ngendelengo may be a distinct language.
